# Pakistan Investment Advisor

> Free, daily-updated educational tools and guides for investing and saving money in Pakistan - comparing National Savings, mutual funds, PSX dividend stocks, gold, T-bills and more, using live market data. Educational only; not financial advice.

Pakistan Investment Advisor (pakinvestlysis.com) helps Pakistani investors and savers compare their options with live figures - the SBP policy rate, KSE-100 index, CPI inflation, PKR/USD, National Savings certificate rates, mutual fund returns and PSX dividend yields - refreshed every day by an automated scraper. Written by Abdul Ahad, a software engineer and personal investor in PSX dividend stocks and Al Meezan mutual funds. All content is educational and does not constitute investment, tax or financial advice; figures should be verified against primary sources (State Bank of Pakistan, FBR, PSX, CDNS) before acting.

## Tools

- [Investment Comparison Tool](https://pakinvestlysis.com/): Compare National Savings, mutual funds and PSX dividend stocks side by side with live daily data - enter an amount and see a personalised analysis.
- [Frequently Asked Questions (searchable)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/faq.html): A directory of 223 concise, sourced answers to common Pakistani investing and tax questions - income tax, GST, filing, mutual funds, PSX stocks, National Savings, prize bonds, gold, Roshan Digital Account and Zakat - filterable by topic, each linking to its full guide.
- [Pakistan Tax Calculator 2026-27](https://pakinvestlysis.com/tax-calculator.html): Calculate salaried or business/AOP income tax (FY2026-27 slabs), GST on goods (18%), provincial sales tax on services, and restaurant bill tax (incl. the reduced card/digital rate), with a year-on-year comparison chart. Educational, not advice.
- [Zakat Calculator Pakistan 2026](https://pakinvestlysis.com/zakat-calculator.html): Work out Zakat at 2.5% of net zakatable wealth (cash, gold, silver, investments, business assets minus debts) with the nisab set from the current gold or silver price. Educational, not a religious ruling.
- [Gold Rate in Pakistan Today + Forecast Calculator](https://pakinvestlysis.com/gold-rates.html): Live 24K and 22K gold price per tola, 10 gram and gram (updated daily from local Sarafa rate with international spot fallback), a 6-year price-history chart, and a forecast calculator that projects the future value of a gold investment versus National Savings and inflation. Educational, not advice.

## Guides

- [Best Dividend Stocks on PSX for Passive Income (2026)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/best-dividend-stocks-psx.html): Which PSX stocks pay the highest dividends, how to judge yield sustainability and avoid yield traps, and how to build a passive-income portfolio of KSE-100 blue chips.
- [How to Invest in Mutual Funds in Pakistan (2026)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/how-to-invest-mutual-funds-pakistan.html): Beginner's step-by-step guide - choosing Islamic vs conventional funds, opening an account online, and starting a SIP from PKR 1,000.
- [National Savings vs Mutual Funds in Pakistan (2026)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/national-savings-vs-mutual-funds.html): A detailed comparison of CDNS National Savings schemes and SECP-regulated mutual funds - returns, risk, liquidity, taxes, and who each suits.
- [Money Market Funds vs Bank Savings Accounts (2026)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/money-market-funds-vs-bank-savings.html): Why Pakistani bank savings accounts pay below the policy rate, how money market funds work, and an honest comparison of returns, access, protection and tax.
- [How to Buy T-Bills and PIBs in Pakistan: IPS Account Guide (2026)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/treasury-bills-pakistan.html): Buy Government of Pakistan T-bills and PIBs through an IPS account - documents, auction bids, taxes, risks, and when a money market fund is the smarter route.
- [How to Open a Brokerage Account for PSX (2026)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/open-brokerage-account-psx.html): Choosing a TREC-holder broker, understanding your CDC sub-account and Sahulat accounts, fees, taxes, and placing your first trade.
- [Gold Investment in Pakistan: Physical, Digital & Gold Funds (2026)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/gold-investment-pakistan.html): Tola pricing, 24k vs 22k purity, making charges, gold-backed mutual funds, PMEX contracts, and how much gold belongs in a portfolio.
- [Halal Investing in Pakistan (2026): Islamic Funds, Sukuk & Shariah Stocks](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/halal-investing-pakistan.html): Building a fully halal portfolio - Islamic mutual funds, GoP Ijara sukuk, KMI-30 Shariah-compliant stocks and Islamic savings accounts, with the screening rules explained.
- [How Investments Are Taxed in Pakistan: Filer vs Non-Filer (2026)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/investment-tax-pakistan.html): How becoming an ATL tax filer roughly halves withholding tax on dividends, savings profit and fund returns; IRIS/ATL steps, CGT via NCCPL, and Zakat rules.
- [Roshan Digital Account (RDA): Guide for Overseas Pakistanis (2026)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/roshan-digital-account-guide.html): How Non-Resident Pakistanis open an RDA and invest in PSX stocks, mutual funds and Naya Pakistan Certificates from abroad.
- [SBP Policy Rate Explained for Pakistani Investors (2026)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/sbp-policy-rate-investments.html): Why the State Bank policy rate is the single most important number for investors, and how rate cuts and hikes move National Savings, mutual funds and PSX stocks.
- [How to Become a Filer in Pakistan (FBR IRIS, 2026)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/how-to-become-filer-pakistan.html): Step-by-step - register an NTN on IRIS, file your return and wealth statement, and get on the Active Taxpayer List to roughly halve the withholding tax non-filers pay.
- [Freelancer & IT Exporter Tax in Pakistan (2026)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/freelancer-tax-pakistan.html): How freelancers and IT exporters are taxed - the 0.25% concessional final tax for PSEB-registered exporters vs 1%, the Section 65F conditions, repatriation/remittance rules, and local-client income on the normal slabs.
- [Prize Bonds in Pakistan (2026)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/prize-bonds-pakistan.html): How prize bonds work - denominations, the quarterly draws, why they pay no fixed return, tax on winnings (filer ~15% vs non-filer ~30%), the Shariah question, and how they compare to National Savings.
- [Naya Pakistan Certificates 2026: Rates, Tax &amp; Investing](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/naya-pakistan-certificates-pakistan.html): Naya Pakistan Certificates (NPC) for overseas Pakistanis: USD vs PKR rates, tenors, the 10% final tax, no-filer advantage, minimums and how to buy via RDA.
- [Investing in Pakistan from the Gulf: NRP Guide (2026)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/overseas-pakistani-investment-guide.html): A practical 2026 roadmap for overseas Pakistanis in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and beyond to invest back home via Roshan Digital Account, NPCs, PSX and gold.

## Analysis & Blog

- [How to Value a Bank Stock in Pakistan: Step-by-Step](https://pakinvestlysis.com/blog/how-to-value-bank-stocks-pakistan.html): A bottom-up method for estimating a Pakistani bank's earnings and fair value - balance sheet, net spread, EPS and a P/E valuation with sensitivity analysis. CASA, the advances-to-deposit ratio and bank tax explained.
- [Pakistan Budget 2026-27: Complete Breakdown for Investors](https://pakinvestlysis.com/blog/pakistan-budget-2026-27-investors.html): The FY27 budget decoded - salaried tax slab cuts, the super tax reduction, the petroleum levy, and the impact on National Savings, mutual funds, PSX stocks and gold.
- [Can Budget 2026-27 Push the PSX Higher? Bull vs Bear](https://pakinvestlysis.com/blog/budget-2026-27-stock-market-impact.html): How budgets move stock markets through earnings, discount rates and flows, and how the FY27 measures stack up - the bull case, the bear case, and "sell the news".
- [Budget 2026-27 Tax Slabs Explained for the Salaried Class](https://pakinvestlysis.com/blog/budget-2026-27-tax-slabs-salaried-explained.html): The FY27 salaried tax cuts - old vs new rates across four slabs, the abolished surcharge, and worked take-home-pay examples at several income levels.
- [Budget 2026-27 Cut Your Income Tax - 5 Smart Moves](https://pakinvestlysis.com/blog/budget-2026-27-salaried-class-investing.html): Five concrete ways the salaried class can invest the extra take-home pay from July 2026 - SIPs, filer status, money market funds, savings certificates and equities.
- [Pakistan Housing Loan Scheme 2026: Mera Ghar Mera Aashiana](https://pakinvestlysis.com/blog/pakistan-housing-loan-scheme-2026.html): The subsidised home loan of up to Rs 10 million at a fixed 5% for 10 years - who can apply, which banks, the procedure, and what owning a home means for your finances.
- [PM Apna Ghar Scheme Calculator (Ghar Ho Tu Apna)](https://pakinvestlysis.com/blog/pm-apna-ghar-housing-finance-calculator.html): A free calculator for the Wazir-e-Azam Apna Ghar scheme - estimate the monthly installment at 5% fixed for 10 years, the post-10-year 1-year KIBOR + 3% reset, total markup, 10% equity and debt-burden ratio, plus eligibility, limits and how to apply. Uses the banks' fixed-rate amortisation method.
- [Budget 2026-27 Car Taxes in Pakistan](https://pakinvestlysis.com/blog/budget-2026-27-car-taxes-pakistan.html): The FY27 budget's auto taxes - a new Federal Excise Duty on imported cars over 2,000cc (40%) and over 3,000cc (41%) and on luxury imported EVs above Rs 2 crore (30-40%), the fuel carbon levy doubled to Rs 5/litre, the 1% sales tax on local EVs extended to June 2027, and the unchanged NEV levy, registration advance tax and token tax. As reported from the Finance Bill 2026; verify on fbr.gov.pk.
- [Pakistan's Auto Policy 2026-31, Explained](https://pakinvestlysis.com/blog/pakistan-auto-policy-2026-31-explained.html): The draft five-year auto policy - targets of 500,000 vehicles a year and ~$1bn exports by 2031, a phased tariff cut toward a 0/5/10/15% structure with a disputed 40% built-up-import floor, the 1%-vs-18% EV sales-tax standoff with the IMF, the liberalisation of used-car imports, and why the policy was still an unapproved draft as of June 2026. All policy figures are draft proposals.

## Notes

- All content is educational only and is not investment, tax or financial advice. No buy/sell recommendations or price targets are given.
- Market data (policy rate, KSE-100, inflation, PKR/USD, rates, yields) is refreshed daily; treat any figure as a snapshot and verify against primary sources before acting.
- Primary sources referenced: State Bank of Pakistan (sbp.org.pk), FBR (fbr.gov.pk), Pakistan Stock Exchange (psx.com.pk), Central Directorate of National Savings (savings.gov.pk).
